title: Mixed Event — Never Give Up Cooking! — Episode4 The Taste Tester

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and Saki invite Toya over for a party. With White Day approaching, he wants to give something back to the two of them. He tries his hand at baking from scratch, with varying results...

rows.Line: The next day
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'll be baking cupcakes with Miku today after school...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (After what happened yesterday, I thought that my plan had completely fallen apart... But I may yet still have hope thanks to Miku.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I need to succeed this time.
I'm going to bake some cupcakes that Tsukasa and Saki will really enjoy.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, Akito, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You were smiling just now...
Did something good happen to you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not quite, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? And you're gonna bake them yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I say go for it.
I think it's good that you're trying something new.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, me too.
And I'm hoping they turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But you don't really like sweets...
How are you gonna know if they're good?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, yes...well...
I'll be able to tell by...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't eat sweets on a regular basis, so there really is no way for me to properly judge how they taste.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why didn't I realize this sooner...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, there's no need to beat yourself up over this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're making them with Miku, right?
Why don't you just have her taste test them?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It would be nice to also hear from an independent adjudicator.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, don't get your hopes up. Unfortunately, I have work today after school...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, I wish I could find you a replacement...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Uh oh. Homeroom's about to start.
Let's go, Toya.
Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I couldn't find a taste tester...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I suppose I can ask Len, KAITO or someone else later after school...)
Hello there. Do have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Kamishiro!
What are you doing in the first years' corridor...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was hoping to speak with you for a bit. Remember that little discussion we had regarding gifts?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, about that... After we spoke, I took your idea and decided to bake some sweets.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't quite succeed yesterday when I tried... But I found someone who can teach me and we'll be remaking them today after school.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's good to hear. I'm sure Tsukasa and his sister will enjoy your gift. Also, they seem to be looking forward to that dinner party you mentioned very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They are?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I came here to mention that.
I actually met with him earlier today and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, do you have a minute?
There's something I need to tell you regarding practice for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Cover the beef in salt and pepper... Add vegetables and let it stew...? Hm? You throw in the herbs with it here? The order for this recipe is a little different from the other one I saw...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Rui! My apologies! I didn't see you! How long have you been standing there?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Only for a second. Also, what were you mulling over just now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, we've invited Toya over to our house for a dinner party, and I was just reviewing the recipe for the dish we'll be making...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A dinner party...?
I see. That explains why your brow was so furled.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! Since Toya will be visiting, we want to make our party as enjoyable as possible!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Rui, let me hear what you think! I've been trying to decide which of these dishes we should make...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He really couldn't stop talking about you. As such, he's been working very hard to make sure you enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He has...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for telling me this...
Now I feel an even greater incentive to give them something nice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're welcome, and I wish you the best of luck. Also, feel free to ask if you think you need any help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If I need any help...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, I wish I could find you a replacement...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Maybe I can ask Kamishiro...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, but... He's busy preparing for a show. Asking him to be my taste tester seems...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, um... So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. You need someone to taste your creations...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since I was the one who originally suggested that you make some sweets yourself. And did I not just say that you're free to ask me for help?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, I'm not exactly a culinary expert myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I just want to hear your honest opinion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. I should be able to do at least that. So, when do you need me to taste test for you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well, we have tomorrow off...
So I won't be able to bring them to school until next week.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I also have practice with Akito and the others. I'd like him to do this as soon as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I take it you need me to do this soon?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Y-Yes... If possible...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but we can't do much about our day off tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know. If you're okay with it, why don't I come over to your house and taste test for you there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, but... I'm already asking so much of you... Also, I'm sure you're very busy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
Also, we're not having practice today for our show.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really...?
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But I'll be making them with Miku...
I can't let him see her...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Ah, no... I can just...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, would you mind coming over this evening around six? I'll make sure to have them done by that time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that's fine with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, I'll see you then after school.
I'm looking forward to seeing what you bake.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, thank you very much.
I'll do my best to not disappoint you.
